result.summary: 本论文介绍了 Llama 3 系列基础模型，包括 8B、70B 和 405B 三个参数规模的多语言语言模型，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用 [S1.p3]。最大的模型是 405B 参数的稠密 Transformer，上下文窗口最高 128K tokens [abstract]。论文详细描述了预训练（约 15T 多语言 tokens）和后训练（SFT、拒绝采样、DPO）流程，并进行了广泛的实证评估 [S1.p5][S4.p1]。实验表明，旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型质量相当，较小模型在同规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。论文还通过组合式方法将图像、视频和语音能力集成到 Llama 3 中，在识别任务上表现有竞争力，但这些多模态模型仍在开发中，尚未广泛发布 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在开发一套新的基础模型 Llama 3，原生支持多语言、编程、推理和工具使用，并探索通过组合式方法集成图像、视频和语音等多模态能力 [S1.p3][S2.p4]。研究动机在于基础模型是许多现代 AI 系统的基础，而开发高质量基础模型的关键杠杆是数据、规模和复杂度管理 [S1.p1][S1.p4]。作者希望通过公开释放旗舰模型来推动研究社区的创新，并加速负责任地迈向通用人工智能（AGI）[S1.p7]。

evidence.quote: Foundation models are general models of language, vision, speech, and/or other modalities that are designed to support a large variety of AI tasks.
In this paper, we present a new set of foundation models for language, called Llama 3.
We believe there are three key levers in the development of high-quality foundation models: data, scale, and managing complexity.

We hope that the open release of a flagship model will spur a wave of innovation in the research community, and accelerate a responsible path towards the development of artificial general intelligence (AGI).
We also perform experiments in which we add image, video, and speech capabilities to Llama 3 using a compositional approach.

method.text: Llama 3 采用标准的稠密 Transformer 架构，相比 Llama 2 仅有少量修改，如使用分组查询注意力（GQA）、128K 词表和更高的 RoPE 基础频率 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS2.p2]。预训练分为初始预训练、长上下文预训练和退火三个阶段，旗舰模型在 15.6T tokens 上训练，上下文窗口从 8K 逐步扩展到 128K [S2.p2][S3.SS4.p1]。后训练采用基于监督微调（SFT）、拒绝采样（RS）和直接偏好优化（DPO）的简单流程，而非更复杂的强化学习算法 [S1.p5][S4.p1]。多模态能力通过组合式方法集成：分别训练图像和语音编码器，再通过适配器接入预训练语言模型 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: Llama 3 uses a standard, dense Transformer architecture.
We use grouped query attention (GQA;) with 8 key-value heads to improve inference speed and to reduce the size of key-value caches during decoding.
we pre-train a model with 405B parameters on 15.6T tokens using a context window of 8K tokens.
The recipe used to pre-train Llama 3 405B consists of three main stages: (1) initial pre-training, (2) long-context pre-training, and (3) annealing.
we adopt a relatively simple post-training procedure based on supervised finetuning (SFT), rejection sampling (RS), and direct preference optimization (DPO;)
Each round of post-training involves supervised finetuning (SFT) followed by Direct Preference Optimization on examples collected either via human annotations or generated synthetically.
We train separate encoders for images and speech.

experiments.text: 论文对预训练模型、后训练模型和安全特性进行了广泛评估 [S5.p1]。预训练评估覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码等八大类标准基准，并进行了鲁棒性、对抗性和污染分析 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1][S5.SS1.SSS2.p1][S5.SS1.SSS3.p1][S5.SS1.SSS4.p1]。后训练评估包括通用知识（MMLU、MMLU-Pro）、指令遵循（IFEval）、编程（HumanEval、MBPP、MultiPL-E）、多语言（多语言 MMLU、MGSM）、数学推理、长上下文和工具使用等基准，并进行了大规模人类评估 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p2][S5.SS2.SSS3.p2][S5.SS2.SSS4.p1][S5.SS2.SSS5.p1][S5.SS2.SSS6.p1][S5.SS2.SSS7.p1][S5.SS3.p1]。多模态实验在图像识别（MMMU、VQAv2、ChartQA 等）和视频识别（PerceptionTest、NExT-QA 等）以及语音识别和翻译任务上进行了评估 [S7.SS6.p1][S7.SS7.p1][S8.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: We performed an extensive series of evaluations of Llama 3, investigating the performance of: (1) the pre-trained language model, (2) the post-trained language model, and (3) the safety characteristics of Llama 3.

These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
We leverage MMLU and MMLU-Pro to evaluate Llama 3’s capability on knowledge-based question answering.
HumanEval and MBPP are popular benchmarks for Python code generation which focus on relatively simple, self-contained functions.
In Table 20, we show results from evaluating Llama 3 on the multilingual MMLU and Multilingual Grade School Math (MGSM) benchmarks.
In addition to evaluations on standard benchmark sets, we also perform a series of human evaluations.

We evaluate the performance of the image understanding capabilities of Llama 3 on a range of tasks spanning natural image understanding, text understanding, charts understanding and multimodal reasoning
We evaluate our video adapter for Llama 3 on three benchmarks
We evaluate the speech understanding capabilities of our speech interface for Llama 3 on three tasks: (1) automatic speech recognition, (2) speech translation, and (3) spoken question answering.

findings.text: 实验表明，旗舰 Llama 3 405B 模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型表现相当，接近最先进水平；较小的 8B 和 70B 模型在同规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。在预训练基准上，Llama 3 8B 几乎在所有类别上优于竞争模型，70B 大幅超越 Llama 2 70B 和 Mixtral 8x22B [S5.SS1.SSS1.p4]。后训练模型在 MMLU、IFEval 等基准上，8B 和 70B 变体优于同规模模型，405B 在 MMLU 上超越 GPT-4 和 Nemotron 4 340B [S5.SS2.SSS1.p3]。人类评估显示，Llama 3 405B 与 GPT-4 0125 版本大致相当，与 GPT-4o 和 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 互有胜负 [S5.SS3.p4]。多模态实验表明，组合式方法在图像、视频和语音识别任务上表现有竞争力 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Our experimental evaluation suggests that our flagship model performs on par with leading language models such as GPT-4 across a variety of tasks, and is close to matching the state-of-the-art.
The results show that Llama 3 8B outperforms competing models in virtually every category, both in terms of per-category win rate and in terms of average per-category performance.
Llama 3 70B also outperforms Mixtral 8x22B.
As shown in Table 2, our 8B and 70B Llama 3 variants outperform other models of similar sizes on both general knowledge tasks.
Our 405B model outperforms GPT-4 and Nemotron 4 340B, with Claude 3.5 Sonnet leading among larger models.
We observe that Llama 3 405B performs approximately on par with the 0125 API version of GPT-4, while achieving mixed results (some wins and some losses) compared to GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
We observe this approach performs competitively with the state-of-the-art on image, video, and speech recognition tasks.

limitations.text: 作者明确指出，多模态模型仍在积极开发中，尚未准备好发布 [S1.p8][S2.p6]。人类评估虽然经过质量保证，但由于难以定义客观标准，仍可能受标注者个人偏见、背景和偏好的影响，导致结果不一致或不可靠 [S5.SS3.p5]。在安全方面，作者承认没有任何测试能保证穷尽所有风险，Llama 3 仍可能生成有害内容，尤其是在英语之外的语言或面对熟练的对抗性红队攻击时 [S5.SS4.SSS8.p1]。此外，安全基准是 Meta 内部的，外部无法复现 [S5.SS4.SSS4.p2]。

evidence.quote: These models are still under active development and not yet ready for release.
These models are still under development and not yet ready for release.

However, since it is challenging to define objective criteria for evaluating model responses, human evaluations can still be influenced by personal biases, backgrounds, and preferences of human annotators, which may lead to inconsistent or unreliable results.
However, no testing can be guaranteed to be exhaustive in identifying every possible risk.
Llama 3 may still generate harmful content due to training on various datasets, particularly for languages beyond English and when prompt engineered by skilled adversarial red teamers.
Because these safety benchmarks are internal to Meta, we acknowledge that the numbers in this section are not reproducible externally
